latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Detector Free — Initial Release

- Detects AI-generated vs. real video content by uploading clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB)
- Automated, ready-to-download 1080p MP4 reports; no manual video editing required
- Designed for journalists, researchers, and content moderators for fast, reliable verification
- Anonymous authentication with 100 free credits for new users, valid 7 days
- Supports user prompts for upload, detection, status, credits, and export through chat interface
- Full session state management and robust error handling included
